concerns.location: plan.md:Technical Context / research.md:Dataset Strategy vs constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: Constitution VI mandates that review data "MUST be obtained directly from the GitHub API as raw pull-request diffs and associated issue metadata" with original JSON payloads stored unchanged under data/raw/. The plan/research instead fetch a single HuggingFace Parquet file (prs-v2-sample) and never touch the GitHub API. This is a direct plan↔constitution conflict; either document a constitution amendment or reconcile the data-acquisition statement.

concerns.location: research.md:Compute Feasibility Plan vs research.md:Phase 1 / plan.md:Constraints
concerns.text: Internal contradiction on model precision: Phase 1 says "default precision (float32)" and the plan's Constraints say "no 8-bit/4-bit quantization", while the Compute Feasibility section states float32 is infeasible (~12GB) and prescribes bfloat16/float16 CPU tensors plus a possible fallback to a 1B-class model. Pick one precision story and state it consistently across plan.md and research.md.

concerns.location: constitution.md:Principle VII vs plan.md:Constitution Check row VII
concerns.text: Principle VII requires test parameters (α = 0.05) to be documented in `analysis/plan.md`. The plan's Constitution Check marks this PASS but no task (T009–T013) creates `analysis/plan.md`; α is only documented in research.md. Add a task/artifact for the analysis plan document or annotate the deviation.

concerns.location: plan.md:Constitution Check row I vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Row I claims seeds are pinned in `src/config/settings.py`, and quickstart offers a `--seed` CLI override. The plan should state whether the CLI override is recorded in the run log / final report provenance so re-runs remain reproducible (Constitution I); currently no task emits the effective seed into an artifact.
